testsuite.name: gspa.integration.workflow.RlcMappingWorkflowSpec

testcase.name: standalone EC mapping is sufficient for RLC anchor lookup
all GO alternatives survive the production mapping path and file order is irrelevant
shared references preserve the same independent multivalued mapping
two GO labels for one EC on the same anchor do not add independent diversity
